RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

params._optimisticOracle: Address of the UMA-compatible Optimistic Oracle.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

initialize(address,bytes,uint8).details: Calls the CTF adapter's `initialize` with a dead reward token and zero reward/bond/liveness.      Reverts if the adapter is not whitelisted, `requiredVotes` is below `minRequiredVotes`,      or the question has already been initialized.

params.ancillaryData: Data used to resolve the condition in the CTF adapter.
params.requiredVotes: The number of votes required to resolve the question.
params.umaCompatibleCtfAdapter: The whitelisted UMA-compatible CTF adapter address.

returns.questionID: The UMA CTF adapter question ID.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.questionIDs: The UMA CTF adapter question IDs.
params.requiredVotes: The number of votes required to resolve the question.
params.umaCompatibleCtfAdapter: The UMA-compatible CTF adapter to switch to.

updateIsUmaCompatibleCtfAdapterWhitelist.details: When whitelisting, validates that the adapter's optimistic oracle matches      `UMA_COMPATIBLE_OPTIMISTIC_ORACLE`. Admin only.

params.isWhitelisted: Whether to whitelist or remove the adapters.
params.umaCompatibleCtfAdapters: The CTF adapter addresses to update.

updateMinRequiredVotes(uint8).details: Does not affect already-initialized questions. Admin only.

params.newMinRequiredVotes: The new minimum. Must be at least 2.

updateRequiredVotes(bytes32,uint8).details: Does not affect already-initialized questions. Admin only.

params.newRequiredVotes: The new required votes. Must be at least `minRequiredVotes`.
params.questionID: The UMA CTF adapter question ID.

vote(bytes32,uint64,bytes).details: Triggers resolution if the vote tips the question over `requiredVotes` for any outcome.      Each caller may only vote once per question.

params.outcome: The outcome to vote for. Must be 0, 0.5 ether, or 1 ether.
params.questionID: The UMA CTF adapter question ID.
The UMA CTF adapter question ID.

returns._0: voteKey The keccak256 hash of the encoded question ID and voter address.

devdoc.title: AdminAdapter

AdminAdapter__InvalidOptimisticOracle().notice: Thrown when a CTF adapter's optimistic oracle does not match `UMA_COMPATIBLE_OPTIMISTIC_ORACLE`.

AdminAdapter__InvalidOutcome().notice: Thrown when the outcome is not one of: 0, 0.5 ether, 1 ether.

AdminAdapter__NoQuestionIDsProvided().notice: Thrown when `switchResolutionProvider` is called with no question IDs.

AdminAdapter__QuestionAlreadyInitialized.notice: Thrown when `initialize` is called for a question that already exists.

AdminAdapter__QuestionAlreadyResolved().notice: Thrown when `switchResolutionProvider` is called for a question that is already resolved.

AdminAdapter__QuestionNotActive().notice: Thrown when an operation requires the question to be in `Status.Active`.

AdminAdapter__QuestionNotInitialized().notice: Thrown when `switchResolutionProvider` is called for a question that is not initialized.

AdminAdapter__RequiredVotesAlreadyReache.notice: Thrown when `updateRequiredVotes` is called for a question that has already reached the required votes.

AdminAdapter__UmaCompatibleCtfAdapterNot.notice: Thrown when the CTF adapter is not in the whitelist.

AdminAdapter__VoteAlreadySubmitted().notice: Thrown when the caller has already submitted a vote for the given question.

AdminAdapter__MinRequiredVotesUpdated(ui.notice: Emitted when the global minimum required votes is updated.

AdminAdapter__QuestionInitialized(bytes3.notice: Emitted when a question is initialized.

AdminAdapter__QuestionResolved(bytes32,a.notice: Emitted when a question is resolved.

AdminAdapter__RequiredVotesUpdated(bytes.notice: Emitted when the required votes for a question is updated.

AdminAdapter__ResolutionProviderSwitched.notice: Emitted when the resolution provider for a question is switched.

AdminAdapter__UmaCompatibleCtfAdaptersWh.notice: Emitted when UMA-compatible CTF adapters are added or removed from the whitelist.

AdminAdapter__VoteSubmitted(bytes32,addr.notice: Emitted when a vote is submitted.

UMA_COMPATIBLE_OPTIMISTIC_ORACLE().notice: The UMA-compatible Optimistic Oracle used to propose and settle prices.

constructor.notice: Sets the Optimistic Oracle address and grants the admin role.

initialize(address,bytes,uint8).notice: Initializes a question in the UMA-compatible CTF adapter.

isUmaCompatibleCtfAdapterWhitelisted(add.notice: Whitelist of UMA-compatible CTF adapters that are allowed to be called.

minRequiredVotes().notice: Minimum number of votes required to resolve any new question.

questions(bytes32).notice: Maps question ID to question data.

switchResolutionProvider(bytes32[],addre.notice: Switches the resolution provider for a question. The purpose of this function is to allow the switcher to switch the resolution provider from 3PO or any upcoming resolution providers to the AdminAdapter if they fail.

updateIsUmaCompatibleCtfAdapterWhitelist.notice: Adds or removes UMA-compatible CTF adapters from the whitelist.

updateMinRequiredVotes(uint8).notice: Updates the global minimum number of votes required to resolve any new question.

updateRequiredVotes(bytes32,uint8).notice: Updates the required votes for a question.

vote(bytes32,uint64,bytes).notice: Cast a vote on a question.

voteKey(bytes32,address).notice: Derives a unique storage key for a voter's vote on a given question.

votes(bytes32).notice: Maps vote key to the vote. The key is a hash of the question ID and the voter's address.
